personalized_score.formula: Σ w·(50 + coverage·(fit − 50)) / Σ w − 0.4 × detour %

routes.ranking_explanation: 3 stop(s), 1.45 km on the OSM pedestrian graph, 18 min walking + 80 min visits. Within your limits.

method: exact enumeration of 3 required stop(s) and slot choices (network walk minus 1500 m per unit of relevance)

matrix.basis: network shortest-path metres (Dijkstra on the OSM pedestrian graph)

itinerary.coverage: Walking routes use the Manhattan OSM pedestrian graph; places elsewhere can be searched but not routed.

notes: Walking time uses a fixed 4.8 km/h planning pace. Visit durations are estimates you can change.
